notes: The PDF has no inventory pages, so Element IDs are inferred from the pictures and the closest catalogue types. Colours are in props.
Step 4 shows the front of the body as stacked plates and bricks. I could not tell every piece, so the base is simplified to plates b1-b4.
The ears (b13, b14) and the black tail bar (b15) are taken from the final photo. Only one ear is clearly visible in the step 8 drawing.
Step 9 adds a three-piece foot or leg assembly (b16-b18). I put its top on the rear body plate, but the stacking direction is uncertain.
The tusks (b5, b6) are white axles clamped between plates. The exact plate each one sits in is a guess.
The exploded leg stack in step 8 (slope, brick, plate) is built twice; the slope joins the underside of the body.

Port reuse fix: each underside connection now uses a separate anti-stud port. b2 is a lego-3022 2x2 plate, which has several anti-stud ports. The first leg uses b1 anti-stud.2, the second leg uses b2 antistud.1.2, and the step 9 assembly uses b2 antistud.1.1.
